name: palette-engine
description: Brand palette builder: screen, print and spot values with the evidence for each choice, and exports for design and print tools.

scripts.test:engine: node build/bundle.mjs && for t in lut lab spot color gamut checks apcastub harmony ouluo matcher palette analyze export ase project sheet files example; do echo "== $t"; node engine/test_$t.mjs || exit 1; done && echo '== tokens' && node web/test_tokens.mjs
scripts.test:web: node build/bundle.mjs && node build/make_page.mjs && echo '== export ui' && node web/test_export_ui.mjs && echo '== end to end' && node web/test_e2e.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test:web

author: Kwade Joslin
